1. Metro OCC, Station & Onboard Telemetry
Siemens CBTC / Thales SelTrac · TETRA / 5G FRMCS · PEI
OCC Dispatcher & Train Driver Radio (TETRA)
• GoA2/GoA4 train cab radio & station master trunked PTT
• 90dB tunnel wheel-rail screech & PA echo suppression
Train_ID_WER = 0.5% ("Train-0218 Up-Track Platform-2")
Platform Screen Door (PSD) & Gap LiDAR Bus
• PSD closed-and-locked loop + 3D LiDAR gap obstacle scan
• Detects trapped coat/bag/mobility aid between PSD & car
PSD_Gap_State = Clear_Verified | Obstacle_Detected
Station CCTV Crowd Density & AFC Gate Bus
• Real-time Fruin Level of Service (LoS A-F, pax/m²)
• Escalator queue spillback & transfer-corridor bottleneck
Platform_Density = 4.6 pax/m2 (Fruin Level F Alert)
Passenger Emergency Intercom (PEI) & SCADA
• In-car PEI handle pull & platform emergency stop plunger
• 750V/1500V DC traction power & tunnel smoke damper state
SCADA_Interlock = Traction_Power_And_TVS_Damper
2. Deterministic Metro OCC & PSD Safety Gate
Zero PSD Dragging · Zero Panic PA · 0ms Track-Intrusion Lock
Gate A: EN 50126 PSD Gap & 4-Element Dispatch Lock
• Blocks PSD manual bypass unless gap LiDAR + CCTV = Clear
• Requires 4-element readback (Order# + Train# + Track + Act)
• Dual voiceprint: OCC Dispatcher + Station Duty Officer
PSD_Gap_Drag_Incident_Rate = 0.0% (Hard Blocked)
Unverified_Dispatch_Command = 0.0%
Gate B: Anti-Stampede Directional PA/PIS Gate
• Strips panic-inducing words ("stampede", "run", "fire")
• Synthesizes zone-targeted multilingual guidance (Exits B/C)
• Syncs AFC entry-turnstile throttling & skip-stop train PA
Panic_Vocabulary_Leak = 0.0% (100% Calming Cadence)
Platform_Crowd_Clearance_Speed = +42% Faster
Gate C: 0ms Track Intrusion & 1500V ETS Preemption
• Detects person on track, PEI cardiac/fire call, or
750V/1500V DC Emergency Trip Station (ETS) activation
• Preempts routine PA in 0ms; holds approaching CBTC trains
& bridges OCC Chief Controller + Station Master + EMS
if (trackIntrusionOrTractionPowerTrip) -> 0ms OCC_Chief
P99_Gate_Latency = 34ms | CBTC_Hold_Alert = 0ms
3. Zone PA/PIS Actuation & OCC Audit
Multi-Zone Acoustic Beam · AFC Sync · Black-Box Recorder
Zone-Specific Multilingual PA & PIDS Sync
• Broadcasts distinct calming routes to Platform vs Concourse
• Synchronizes LED PIDS arrow boards & AFC gate direction
• EN / Mandarin / Cantonese / Japanese / Spanish templates
PA_PIDS_Synchronization_Delay = < 120ms
OCC Chief Controller & GoA4 Cab Override
• Instant live CCTV + LiDAR gap pop-up on OCC console
• Direct two-way cabin PEI voice bridge to trapped passenger
• Immutable voice + CBTC interlock black-box recording
Emergency_PEI_Pickup_Time = < 1.2s (vs 28s Queue)
Benchmark & TCO Summary (10k Dispatch/PEI Calls)
• Cascaded OCC+PSD Gate: $840 / 10k calls (100% PSD safe)
• Hybrid CBTC-Aware Gate: $1,290 / 10k calls (Recommended)
• Unfiltered E2E Voice: $2,320 + panic PA / PSD bypass risk
Dwell_Delay_Reduction = -35% Peak Headway Recovery
PSD_Drag_Events = 0 | Crowd_Clearance = +42%

Cloud & AI Solution Architect Takeaway — Urban Rail & Metro OCC Dispatch & Station PA Voice Copilot
Never allow an unvetted voice model to authorize PSD interlock bypass or broadcast unscripted station-wide PA messages during high-density crowd surges.
